svg.aria-label: The function sin x (blue) and its tangent-line approximations (pink) at three operating points: x0 = 0 gives sin x ≈ x, x0 = π/2 gives sin x ≈ 1, x0 = π gives sin x ≈ π − x. Each is good only near its own point
svg.title: The function sin x (blue) and its tangent-line approximations (pink) at three operating points: x0 = 0 gives sin x ≈ x, x0 = π/2 gives sin x ≈ 1, x0 = π gives sin x ≈ π − x. Each is good only near its own point

g.text: blue: sin x pink dashed: tangent line at x₀
